omar: Heads-up: starting tenant_region_index_swap at 23:50 UTC. tagging @liz @priya. deploy-bot scheduled. rehearsal showed occasional lock spikes.

liz: Ack. What's our fast-fail/abort criteria?

omar: Fast-fail if replica_lag > 12s OR any lock_wait > 7s sustained for 30s. Rollback steps in runbook: pin schema to v20251201_01, disable flag tenants.region_index_live, drop temp index if present. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-index-swap

priya: I'll apply a 90s write-freeze at -2m. API: `POST /internal/flags {"flag":"tenants.region_index_swap","on":true}`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled 'tenant_region_index_swap' for 2025-12-01T23:50Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health gates.

sre-oncall: Preflight checklist: confirm replicas <5s, WAL backlog <30s, sample row count. Escape hatch condensed: abort canary, pin schema, restart writer tier if WAL >45s.

liz: sample SQL: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_regions WHERE needs_index` -- ~62k rows.

omar: canary started routing 5%. initial metrics: latency +4ms, 5xx 0.1%.

priya: flipped flag at 23:48 :white_check_mark: queued job region_index_fill but will pause on lock pressure.

sre-oncall: seeing replica_lag climb 5s -> 9s -> 13s in 6m. hitting warning.

liz: reduce canary to 1% and pause region_index_fill. set safemode `db.lock_timeout=2200ms` for canary region.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaled canary to 1% and paused job 'region_index_fill'.

priya: if we see lock_surges I'll trigger `deploy-bot hold` with reason 'lock_surges'. Who will pin on abort?

omar: I'll run pin. SQL to pin: `UPDATE schema_versions SET active=false WHERE name='tenant_region_index_swap'; INSERT INTO schema_versions(name, active) VALUES('v20251201_01', true);`

ops-runbooks: escape hatch steps: 1) `deploy-bot abort` 2) pin schema 3) flip off tenants.region_index_swap 4) `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS tmp_region_idx` 5) wait for WAL catch-up then restart writers. Manual resume requires ops signoff.

sre-oncall: canary stable at 1% for 8m: latency +2ms, 5xx 0. No WAL backlog growth.

liz: decision: continue 1% another 10m then move to 25% if stable. Escalate if lag > 18s or lock_wait > 10s. Rollback if user errors >0.5% or 5xx spike.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed at 00:02 UTC. advancing to wave2 (25%).

priya: adding brief release note: "tenant_region_index swap: phased canary, short write-freeze, background fill paused on contention."

omar: thanks team  keeping OT watch for wave2 and ready to unwind on threshold breach.
